text:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout for release v4.0.1-canary. Initial traffic: 3% (ap-south-1). Change window: 03/23 06:00-08:00 UTC. Steps: 3% -> 15% -> 40% -> 100%. Observation: 8m per step. Rollback triggers: p99 > 1.2s for 5m OR user error rate > 2% sustained for 2m.
Priya: ack. I'm release owner. tagging @qa and @infra.
Jordan: link to dashboards: https://grafana.local/d/rls/v4-canary (latency + errors).
Mei: quick note: new tokenizer batching enabled in this build; watch sequence-long requests.
Carlos: oncall standing by. If errors spike, call immediate hold and we'll revert weights.
deploy-bot: Canary reached 3% at 06:04 UTC. Observing.
Mei: initial telemetry looks OK, p99 ~950ms but trending down as caches warm.
Jordan: seeing a small error cluster from a third-party upstream at 06:07, not app-level. marking as external.
Priya: decision: continue to 15% at 06:12 if no internal regressions. Anyone object?
Carlos: +0. No objections.
deploy-bot: Scheduled increase to 15% at 06:12 UTC.
Mei: at 06:11, I see KV-cache thrash on one canary host; eviction rate up 3x. correlates with long-seq requests.
Priya: ok lower-level signal. Do we want to change next step size (15% -> 10%) or proceed?
Jordan: suggestion: reduce next step to 10% and increase observation to 12m. safer given cache behavior.
Carlos: vote: reduce to 10% and extend watch.
Priya: approved. Updated rollout: 3% -> 10% (12m) -> 40% -> 100%. deploy-bot please update.
deploy-bot: Rollout plan updated by Priya at 06:16 UTC. Next step now 10% at 06:18 UTC.
deploy-bot: Increase to 10% executed at 06:18 UTC.
Jordan: right after step, error rate nudged from 0.3% to 0.9%—mostly 500s tied to one backend pool.
Mei: isolating the affected backend, starting repro against staging.
Carlos: I'm removing the bad backend from the pool now.
deploy-bot: Traffic diverted away from failing backend at 06:21 UTC. Canary error rate dropping.
Priya: status check: p99 back to ~820ms, errors 0.35%. good.
Mei: still seeing cache evictions but they're limited; fallback plan ready: pin canary to model v4.0.1-q8 which uses smaller KV footprint.
Priya: don't pin unless evictions become sustained for 10m. for now continue. We'll note this in release notes.
Jordan: updating release notes draft: "Staged rollout paused briefly to mitigate external 5xx and observed increased KV evictions in canary. No rollback."
Carlos: ops note: pre-baked q8 image is available in ap-south-1 standby if needed: `infra image list | grep v4.0.1-q8`.
Priya: consensus: advance to 40% at 06:40 if metrics stable for next 12m. otherwise keep at 10% and reevaluate.
Mei: +1. I'll keep an eye on long-seq traces and KV eviction metrics.
deploy-bot: Next automatic step scheduled for 06:40 UTC. Manual confirm required per owner Priya.
Priya: I'll confirm at 06:40. ping me 06:39.
Jordan: thanks team. filing a short postmortem checklist in the release ticket so we capture the cache notes. :slightly_smiling_face:
